label: ESTIMATE
assignment: 300 m presence-block inversion of the 128 published (file, score) pairs
mechanism: DTI = TP/(0.2D+0.8N) has no TP in the denominator, so each published score fixes the truth credit of its own dot set; a presence design at the kernel radius makes the fitted coefficient the credit of one emitted dot
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: fault-density selection: if the scored public subset is unusually fault-rich, a dispersed field inherits a higher capture rate with no skill (H-selection)
statistic: leave-one-file-out prediction of 128 published OWNER-REPORT scores

non_discriminating.why: 206,895 dots on a 5 px lattice (746x659); its 3 px neighbourhood covers 99.96% of the footprint, so overlap with it is uninformative and the <70% rule has an empty feasible set

encoding: finite 0 payload + GDAL internal mask band; no NaN stored; shared portal range gate passes
negative_results: block counts beat exact-dot incidence but lose to presence (0.0330 vs 0.0205)
averaging designs at 2/3/4/6 px did not beat 3 px alone
checking the uniqueness ratio incrementally collapses the estimate to 0.121; the quota must come from the final dot count
the earlier '0.369' was a projection from the coarser exact-dot model (LOO sigma 0.052); it is retired
